name: Curt Covill
prior_offices: Sublette County coroner (listed on the official coroner page; he was re-elected in 2026)
background: Curt Covill is the Sublette County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official coroner page lists him in that office and describes the statutory duty to investigate unattended, violent, accidental, and other specified deaths under Title 7, Chapter 4 of Wyoming statutes.
